identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy in Treating Patients With Stage II Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Study of Hypofractionated 3D-CRT/MRT Versus Conventionally Fractionated 3D-CRT/MRT in Patients With Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: Conventional 3D-CRT
armGroups.description: Conventional 3D-CRT or IMRT to 73.8 Gy in 41 fractions

armGroups.label: Hypofractionated 3D-CRT
armGroups.description: Hypofractionated 3D-CRT or IMRT to 70 Gy in 28 fractions

interventions.name: Conventional 3D-CRT or IMRT
interventions.description: Radiation therapy will be given once daily, five days a week, at 1.8 Gy per fraction, for 41 fractions and a total dose of 73.8 Gy

interventions.name: Hypofractionated 3D-CRT or IMRT
interventions.description: Radiation therapy will be given once daily, five days a week, at 2.5 Gy per fraction, for 28 fractions and a total dose of 70 Gy.
